notes.text: Atomic token lookup: own replay → existingOrder, no reprice / authorization / insertion (UC01-MG02). Foreign token → refusal. Only unused tokens continue. Busy → suggestions (UC01-MG03); changed fingerprint OR T → revisedQuote; nothing saved (UC01-MG01).
Persistence: loaded/saved through data access — see 4.3.2.

continuation: Part A ↔ PartB. Same lifelines / same operation; no second request.
realisation_note: Simulator approve/decline choice precedes this request. Short atomic checkout begins before token lookup. Own existing token → existingOrder, no reprice, authorization or insertion (UC01-MG02). Foreign token → refusal. Unused token rechecks eligibility, raw radius, capacity, voucher and full consent.
refresh_policy: Explicit shared-model statuses only; matching signatures never clear behavioral targets.
